title: Fidelity contour signalization benchmarking for quant profiles
creator: Mei Chen
description: Build a reproducible, automated benchmarking harness that produces fidelity-contour visualizations mapping quantization profiles (FP16 / INT8 / INT4 and per-layer hybrid configurations) against both performance (tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency) and quality metrics (instruction-follow score, embedding similarity, hallucination rate) across representative workloads. The goal is to surface stable operating regions and rare failure modes, enable regression detection in CI, and provide artifact outputs suitable for Console dashboards and Optimize recommendations.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harness runs end-to-end with configurable workloads and outputs standardized CSV/Parquet with columns: model, quant_profile, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, IF_score, embed_cosine_mean, hallucination_rate, seed
2) Generates contour heatmaps (tokens/sec vs IF_score) and p95 overlays for each workload group
3) Nightly CI job executes baseline suite and posts regression summary to Slack when quality or latency regresses beyond thresholds
4) Regression detector flags both absolute threshold breaches and statistically significant shifts (CUSUM or Bayesian change point) with links to artifacts
5) Integration tests cover data ingestion -> visualization -> alerting pipeline
6) Documentation and runbook added to Confluence for interpreting contours and recommended mitigations
comments: 2026-02-21 - Mei: Kickoff meeting with PM and a couple SREs. Agreed representative workloads: chat-completion (dialogue turns), summarization (long context), code-gen (varying seq lengths). Capture KV reuse scenarios.

2026-02-25 - Jared: PoC runner implemented: parameterized generator that spawns load clients with variable seq_len and cache_reuse. Outputs CSV. Observed noisy p95 variance for INT4 on dialogue workload when seq_len > 1024.
2026-03-01 - Design feedback (Kavya): Visualization should surface both aggregate quality (IF_score) and rare failure tail (hallucination_rate) — added per-run point annotations for outliers.

2026-03-03 - Eng review (R&D): Debate around quality metric: embedding cosine vs instruction-following token-based score. Decided to use both — embedding similarity as primary continuous signal and IF_score (heuristic instruction pass rate) for rule-based alerts.
2026-03-04 - Jared: Incorporated CUSUM-based shift detector with configurable sensitivity. Early runs show it triggers on small but consistent drift between FP16 baseline and INT8 mixed-layer config.

2026-03-07 - PM (Asha): Set alerting thresholds: IF_score delta > 3 points OR embedding cosine drop > 0.04 triggers Slack alert and creates a regression ticket template. P95 latency increase > 20% also triggers alert.

2026-03-09 - Observed regression: INT4 per-layer quantization produced 12% higher tokens/sec but a 7-point IF_score drop on code-gen workload with long tails. Captured artifacts and added to comparison folder.
2026-03-11 - Decision: implement selective per-layer hybrid quantization (keep attention/mix-ffn in fp16) as mitigation strategy; plan to add automated per-layer sensitivity probe stage to harness.

2026-03-12 - Jared: Opened PR #428 with core harness + CI pipeline config. Requesting review from infra and SRE for rate-limited nightly runs. Next: add per-layer probe, integrate visualization export, and hook regression detector to oncall channel.
next_steps:
1) Add per-layer sensitivity probe and automatic candidate suggestion (preserve top-k layers in FP16)
2) Harden CI job resource quotas and add synthetic load runner to avoid noisy production sampling
3) Wire artifacts to Console Optimize recommendations and expose contour PNGs/JSON in the dashboard
4) Run expanded sweep across model family variants and collect baseline for release-2.4
notes: Trade-offs considered: embedding-similarity is robust for semantic drift but can mask token-level hallucinations; IF_score heuristics catch instruction failures but are brittle across prompt styles. Compute cost for exhaustive per-layer sweeps is high — plan sampling heuristics (bayesian optimization) to find Pareto frontier. Regression detection tuned to avoid noisy alerts (use holdout of 10 nightly runs for stability).
